content: The fastest animal on land is the cheetah, which can reach speeds of up to 70 miles per hour (112 kilometers per hour). However, if we consider all animals across different environments, the peregrine falcon is the fastest, capable of diving at speeds over 200 miles per hour (320 kilometers per hour) during its hunting stoop.
